data.name: Primary Objective
data.text: To assess the potential efficacy of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Secondary Safety and Tolerability Objective
data.text: To assess the safety of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Secondary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To assess additional efficacy measures of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacokinetic Objective
data.text: To characterize the pharmacokinetics of LY4395089 when co-administered with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Exploratory Pharmacodynamic Objective
data.text: To characterize the pharmacodynamic effects of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Objective
data.text: To explore biomarkers associated with response to LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Exploratory Immunogenicity Objective
data.text: To evaluate the immunogenicity of LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration compared with mirikizumab in adults with moderately to severely active Crohn's Disease

data.name: Primary Efficacy Endpoint
data.text: Endoscopic response or clinical response (by CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1, as defined in the IIBD master protocol

data.name: Adverse Events Endpoint
data.text: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs), including adverse events of special interest (AESIs), from baseline through safety follow-up

data.name: Serious Adverse Events Endpoint
data.text: Incidence and severity of serious adverse events (SAEs) from baseline through safety follow-up

data.name: Clinical Laboratory Tests Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in clinical safety laboratory tests (hematology, clinical chemistry, coagulation, urinalysis, lipids) through end of study

data.name: Vital Signs Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in vital signs (pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature) through end of study

data.name: Electrocardiogram Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in 12-lead ECG parameters through end of study

data.name: Bone Mineral Density Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in bone mineral density as assessed by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA scan) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: CDAI Clinical Response Endpoint
data.text: Clinical response as measured by Crohn's Disease Activity Index (CDAI) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Endoscopic Response Endpoint
data.text: Endoscopic response as assessed by Simple Endoscopic Score for Crohn's Disease (SES-CD) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in fecal calprotectin at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: hsCRP Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) at Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: LY4395089 Predose PK Endpoint
data.text: Predose steady-state plasma concentration of LY4395089 collected at Visit 4 (Week 4) in the LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration treatment group

data.name: LY4395089 Postdose PK Endpoint
data.text: Postdose plasma concentration of LY4395089 collected as close as possible to 4 hours post LY4395089 administration at Visit 5 (Week 8) in the LY4395089/mirikizumab co-administration treatment group

data.name: FGF19 Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in FGF19 levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: 7alphaC4 Bile Acid Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in 7alphaC4 bile acid levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Bone Turnover Markers Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in bone turnover markers (P1NP, CTX-1, bone-specific ALP) through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Vitamin D Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Parathyroid Hormone Pharmacodynamic Endpoint
data.text: Change from baseline in parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Exploratory Blood Biomarker Endpoint
data.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from blood samples collected at baseline and through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Exploratory Stool Supernatant Biomarker Endpoint
data.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from stool supernatant samples collected at baseline and through Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Exploratory Colonic Tissue Biomarker Endpoint
data.text: Exploratory biomarkers measured from colonic tissue obtained from endoscopic biopsy at screening and Week 12 of Study Period 1

data.name: Immunogenicity Endpoint
data.text: Incidence of anti-drug antibodies (ADA) to LY4395089 and mirikizumab through end of study
